findings.title: Shard-split queries are interpolated again during execution
findings.body: These targets are interpolated here before shard discovery and shard-selector rewriting, but each generated `subRequest` is later passed to `runSplitQuery` (line 163), which now also calls `applyTemplateVariables`. This applies template replacement twice to every shard-split query. Template values containing variable syntax or other replacement tokens can therefore be expanded a second time, changing the query sent to Loki from the value the user selected. Avoid re-interpolating already-prepared shard targets, or ensure the delegated path knows they are already interpolated.
